intent.proves: Every recurring order schedule points at an existing base order.
intent.scope: all recurring order schedules; complete enumeration

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(r.RecurringOrderId AS nvarchar(20)) + N' -> ' + ISNULL(r.RecurringOrderBaseOrderID, N'') FROM EcomRecurringOrder r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomOrders o WHERE o.OrderId = r.RecurringOrderBaseOrderID)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
